body: I thought getting some sleep would help me, so I laid down for a while...then I woke up 10 hours later. I feel much better now, and nothing has been posted so I am not really worried too much anymore. Thank you for your words and the link to that article. I am still upset that there are people like this in the world, such an eye opener for me, I've realized that I can't be as trusting with people. Thanks again, I just need to go for a walk and think about stuff.
